technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt Node.js fabric-sdk-node architecture patterns for client interaction with peers and orderers.
Enforce invocation restrictions via a validation middleware/interceptor layer in peer proposal handling to permit only LCCC or authorized user chaincodes.
Update standard Protobuf block schemas across ledger packages and standardize helper functions for test transaction creation.
Isolate mock MSP providers in ledger unit tests to decouple ledger testing from MSP crypto configuration.
Implement peer state migration hooks to ensure local state persistence across binary protocol upgrades.
assumptions: Developer is experienced in Go, Node.js, Protobufs, and Hyperledger Fabric v1.0 architecture.
Existing Gerrit patches (1795, 2581) and fabric design specifications are accessible for reference.
The Node SDK task covers the foundational SDK client library (enabling connection, identity management, transaction creation, and proposal submission), not a comprehensive enterprise suite.
CI/CD infrastructure and Docker container test environments are already provisioned.

activities.activity_name: Documentation and Onboarding Structure Setup (U1, U6)
activities.activity_description: Restructure documentation landing pages, establish clear navigation to v0.6 stable docs versus v1.0 development docs, and update quickstart guides for new visitors.
Define and document the channel creation configuration transaction fields, protobuf schemas, default values, and example payload generators matching FAB-687 and Gerrit 1795.

activities.activity_name: Peer Upgrade and Non-Destructive Data Migration Support (U3)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement protocol patch mechanisms via System Chaincode (SCC) and peer state upgrade routines ensuring data persistence across protocol version upgrades.

activities.activity_name: Ledger Block Structure Refactoring and MSP Test Decoupling (U4)
activities.activity_description: Refactor remaining ledger code and unit test transaction constructors to use the updated block structure, and decouple MSP security dependencies from ledger unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Fabric v1.0 Architecture Presentation and Demo Assets (U5)
activities.activity_description: Create architectural diagrams, visual aids, and reproducible demo scripts demonstrating v1.0 architecture and behavior as of Sprint 6.
Implement request validation checks in peer transaction proposal handlers to restrict invocations strictly to LCCC or approved user chaincodes.
Develop the foundational Node.js SDK modules allowing Node applications to register identities, assemble proposals, submit transactions to orderers, and process event streams.
